course_outline_concepts: OpenMathInstruct 1/2: 1.8M → 14M CoT traces via Mixtral → Llama-3.1-405B teacher
MathScale / MetaMath / MAmmoTH: concept-graph, self-verify-FOBAR, hybrid CoT+PoT
rStar / rStar-Math: MCTS + self-verification for small-model math
s1 (Muennighoff 2025), LIMO (Ye 2025): 1000-trace curated sets beat massive sets
Step-level: Step-DPO + OmegaPRM automated MC labeling — bridge to PRM

sources.what_to_extract: 1.8M Mixtral-8x7B-generated TIR traces; K=32-64 solutions per problem; <llm-code>/<llm-code-output> interleaving; SymPy + exact-match filter; ~120 solutions per GSM8K problem; OpenMath-Mistral-7B 80.2 GSM8K / 44.5 MATH.
14M Llama-3.1-405B traces; 600K augmented problems via paraphrase + novel-question; K≈32 CoT at T=1.0, top-p 0.95; 91.7 GSM8K / 67.8 MATH on 8B; stronger teacher > more data.
Concept-graph (2K topics × 5K knowledge points) from GPT-3.5 extraction; rare-edge sampling; 2M MathScaleQA; self-consistency (teacher authors both problem and answer) is the weakness.
Four operators: AnsAug / Rephrasing / Self-Verification (SV) / FOBAR; 395K MetaMathQA; FOBAR = mask a number, known answer, solve backward; ablation shows additive gains.
Hybrid CoT+PoT (PoT:CoT ≈ 57:43); MathInstruct 260K from 14 sources; def solution() template executed for PoT filter; MATH drop -8 CoT-only, -4 PoT-only.
Three-stage Recall→Extract→Refine web-instruction pipeline; fastText+DeBERTa classifier; 10M WEBINSTRUCT pairs; no gold filter, ~8% error.
Five-action set A1-A5; mutual-consistency verification (mask-half + discriminator completion); LLaMA2-7B 12.5 → 63.1 GSM8K without fine-tuning; 32 MCTS rollouts.

Code-augmented MCTS (step = thought + Python, exception → prune); Process Preference Model pairwise Bradley-Terry on Q-value siblings; four-round self-evolution; 747K trajectories; Qwen2.5-Math-7B 90.0 MATH / 53.3 AIME24.
s1K = 1000 curated traces from 59K candidate pool; Gemini-generated; Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct base; budget forcing via 'Wait' token; 56.7 AIME24 / 93.0 MATH500 / 59.6 GPQA-Diamond; 26 min on 16 H100.
817 long-CoT samples; hand-curated; Less-Is-More Reasoning Hypothesis; 63.3 AIME24 / 95.6 MATH500; reflective traces with backtracking; base-model dependence.

Step-DPO loss (same functional form as DPO, single-step completion); ~10K (prefix, step_correct, step_incorrect) triplets; Qwen2-7B 53.0 → 58.6 MATH; beats 100K full-trajectory DPO; first-error-locate via stronger teacher.
Divide-and-conquer MC: O(K·log L) rollouts to locate first-error step; MC(s_t) = fraction of K completions from prefix reaching gold; 1.5M labels; Gemini Pro MATH 51 → 69.4 with weighted best-of-N.
Token-level latent thoughts during continued pretraining; GSM8K zero-shot 5.9 → 10.9; contrast to chapter's post-training reasoning-trace synthesis.
860K problems; cn_k12 is 470K (untapped Chinese textbook source); CoT + TIR splits; GPT-4o teacher; SymPy-boxed verifier; AIMO Progress Prize winner; seed pool for s1/LIMO.
